title: Add 10 new wallpaper options to the personalization panel

requirements.text: Add the following 10 uploaded images as new selectable wallpaper options in the PersonalizationPanel and Personalization page, alongside the existing wallpaper choices. Each option should display a thumbnail and a label. The new wallpapers are: (1) White Plaid with Lace Trim, (2) Pink Polka Dot with Black Lace Border, (3) Leopard Union Jack (black & white), (4) Zebra Print with Quilted Leather & Fleur-de-lis, (5) Mixed Lace Leopard Scrollwork, (6) Domo Black, (7) Silver Angel Wings, (8) Dark Stussy Grunge Leopard, (9) Dark Cheetah Fur, (10) Black Floral Lace. All images must be served as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced in the usePersonalization hook's wallpaper list.

quotes: For last add these wallpaper options

acceptanceCriteria: All 10 new wallpaper thumbnails appear in the PersonalizationPanel grid alongside existing options
All 10 new wallpaper thumbnails appear on the Personalization settings page
Selecting any new wallpaper sets it as the full-page background across the site
Selected wallpaper persists in localStorage via usePersonalization hook
All wallpaper image files are placed in frontend/public/assets/generated
Each option displays a human-readable label matching the descriptions above

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Wallpaper images must be served as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated — do not route through the backend
nonGoals: Removing or modifying any existing wallpaper options
Adding new pages or navigation items

required: White diagonal plaid pattern on light grey/white background with black lace trim along the bottom edge and a small black treble clef icon in the upper right corner (wallpaper-white-plaid-lace.dim_1280x720.png)
Pale pink background covered in evenly spaced small black polka dots, with wide black floral lace bands along the top and bottom edges (wallpaper-pink-polka-dot-lace.dim_1280x720.png)
Black background with a Union Jack flag shape filled entirely with black-and-white snow leopard fur print (wallpaper-leopard-union-jack.dim_1280x720.png)

Dark brown quilted diamond-pattern leather texture on top and bottom thirds, with a centre band of high-contrast black-and-white zebra print stripes and a silver fleur-de-lis emblem overlaid on the lower left (wallpaper-zebra-quilted.dim_1280x720.png)

White background collage blending black floral lace overlay on the left, soft blurred snow leopard fur in the centre, and black baroque scrollwork illustration on the lower right (wallpaper-mixed-lace-leopard.dim_1280x720.png)

Pure black background with a white-outlined cartoon Domo-kun character (boxy brown monster with jagged open mouth and round white eyes) standing in the left half, waving one arm (wallpaper-domo-black.dim_1280x720.png)

Pure black background with a pair of large, symmetrical metallic silver feathered angel wings spread wide and centred, rendered with high-detail shiny feathers (wallpaper-silver-wings.dim_1280x720.png)

Distressed grunge texture combining horizontal paint-smear streaks in black, white, and raw umber with overlapping leopard/cheetah spot prints in dark brown and tan tones (wallpaper-dark-stussy-grunge.dim_1280x720.png)
Close-up macro of dark charcoal and black cheetah fur, showing large irregular black spots on a deep grey background with visible fine fur texture (wallpaper-dark-cheetah.dim_1280x720.png)
Dense all-over black floral lace pattern — large roses and leaf motifs rendered in black net lace — on an off-white/cream background (wallpaper-black-floral-lace.dim_1280x720.png)
